title: Azusawa Kohane — American Style?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this the apparel boutique you wanted to visit, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! The storefront looked really cool, so I have a good feeling about it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a boutique?
Just at first glance, they've got some nice stuff here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and much of it is different from what you see in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The men's section is... In the back.
We're gonna go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be browsing this area.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be back in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now then, since we're here, let's take a good look at what they have!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
How awesome is this hoodie?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, it's cool how the logo looks like graffiti...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! I wish I could pull off an outfit with something like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think it'd look really good on you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! Thanks!
Since I have the chance, I might just try it on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, maybe the outfit on that mannequin...

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “Are you interested in this outfit, miss?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Umm...
“Yes, it looks very cool...”

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
“You have a good eye.
This is a new one that we just got in today.”

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “Would you like to try it on?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “N-No, it wouldn't look good on me...!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
“I disagree, Kohane!
You should try it on!”

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “I agree! Who knows? You might just see yourself in a completely new light!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
“Can I take a picture of her?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna show Miku... I mean, I wanna show everyone that you're trying a new type of fashion!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “I know just the pose that'll make you look super cool.”

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “First, do this with your hands. Bring this one out in front of your face like this. Here, give it a try.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's what rappers do when they yell, “Yo, check it!”

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “You're trying on a cool new look, so you need to strike a cool pose too.”

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: “Hmm... Not bad. But you'll sound cooler if you project your voice a little more.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
“What...?
But won't I bother the other customers...?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, that was really cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were only gone for a second. What happened?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two certainly seem to be enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, the clerk gave us some tips about fashion and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, one of my friends just sent me a message...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(She wants my advice...?
What could this be about?)
